description: Rakuten affiliate click redirect on click.linksynergy.com/fs-bin/click. The link code page publishes the affiliate id, the offer id with its link id, an optional sub-publisher id, and the link type. Conversion pixels on track.linksynergy.com/ep stay vendor/rakuten. Audience Engine u1 and u5 stay out.

params.name: id
params.description: It is the affiliate id. Rakuten documents an 11-character alphanumeric tracking id, also called the encrypted id.
params.fix_hint: Copy id from the link code in the Publisher Dashboard. It is 11 letters or digits.

params.name: offerid
params.description: It is the numeric offer id and the numeric link id, joined with a dot. The link code page writes offerid=7097 and then .10000034.
params.fix_hint: Set offerid to the offer id, a dot, and the link id, such as 7097.10000034.

params.name: subid
params.description: It identifies a sub-publisher when one applies. The published example sends 0 and says no value was passed, so a missing subid is accepted.
params.fix_hint: Send the sub-publisher number, or subid=0 when there is no sub-publisher.

params.name: type
params.description: It is the link type. Rakuten documents 1 email, 2 product, 3 text, 4 banner, 5 search box, 10 deep links, 13 flex links, 14 dynamic rich media, 15 product catalog, and 20 showcase.
params.fix_hint: Set type to the code for this link, such as 4 for a banner or 3 for text.
